lede: The gondola project — the longest-running civic question in this valley — comes to a head Monday when the Gondola Leadership Committee meets with background and history flagged as an action item, not just a briefing, alongside a full review of the CIG funding commitments. Wednesday, Parks and Recreation takes up the already-approved paving of the Town Park grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts, a project that's drawn more than 400 signatures in opposition — that's a meeting worth showing up to.

notable.stake: Gondola history listed as action item; CIG funding and project direction on table.
Contested Town Park paving for courts reviewed; 400+ residents signed in opposition.
